objective: Extend the completed ISE-01 native Scene presentation host with governed token projections, control-state projection, measurement/path previews, proposal-only tactical movement and profile-authorized area-template previews while preserving canonical Character, Creature/NPC, Vehicle, Scene, Action/Event, Combat, permission and movement ownership.

token_projection.identity_rule: A token carries an external owner-domain object reference and authorized Scene projection identity; ISE-02 creates no Character/Creature/Vehicle identity ledger.
token_projection.footprint: Optional owner/profile-supplied footprint only; no universal size rules are inferred.
token_projection.facing_elevation: Optional and rendered only when explicit owner/profile evidence authorizes the field.
token_projection.attachments: Mount/attachment references are consumed as supplied relationship evidence and do not create or mutate relationship ownership.

control.rule: Control state is projected from already-authorized permission/ownership evidence and may be controlled, view-only or denied; ISE-02 cannot grant control authority.
control.hidden_filtering: Hidden/GM-only tokens and protected cardinality must be filtered before they enter the ISE-02 projection.

measurement.purpose: Presentation preview over supplied Scene/profile units or explicit relative geometry only.

persistence.reason: ISE-02 emits presentation state and owner-domain proposals only; canonical accepted movement/relationships remain persisted by their existing owners.

nonauthorization: ISE-05 levels/elevation reality-layer ownership beyond explicit projected elevation values

validation_contract.final_gate: Exact candidate head must pass the current-family selector/Repository Health, bounded ISE-02 self-hosted Linux and Windows Validation Core, and deterministic cross-platform comparison before merge.

preserved_boundaries: ISE-01 remains completed_verified; NativeSceneCanvas stays the presentation host and is not replaced by a second canvas ledger.
A6 remains Action proposal/decision/atomic-result authority; ISE-02 movement handoff is a proposal only.
A7 semantic position remains authoritative; pixel/token coordinates are presentation data only.
Character, Creature/NPC, Vehicle, Scene, Combat, permission and movement-owning domains remain canonical.
Templates preview geometry/authorized candidate targets only and cannot invent targeting, damage, collision or effect truth.
No migration, paid provider activation, unauthorized media redistribution, tester distribution, release or deployment is authorized.
